title: Locke Extension — managed policy
description: Enterprise-administrator-controlled settings for the Locke browser extension. Values delivered via chrome.storage.managed (Chrome ExtensionSettings policy / Firefox 3rdparty policy / managed-storage manifest). Where present, managed values override user-local settings.

allowedProviders.description: Whitelist of provider IDs the shim is allowed to operate on. Empty array or unset means all built-in providers are allowed.

telemetryEnabled.description: Whether shape-only telemetry events (drift signals, mask success/failure counts — never request bodies) are logged to the service-worker console. No data leaves the device regardless.

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often the extension probes the Locke desktop app for health. Lower = faster failure detection, more CPU. Higher = longer recovery time after the desktop app restarts.

debugLogging.description: Whether the capture path prints its normal-path decisions (allow / redact / out-of-scope) to the browser console. Warnings for a blocked or unscreened send are printed regardless of this setting. Shape-only either way: host, path, byte counts, media types and decisions — never request bodies or header values.

enforceTimeoutMs.description: How long the page-side shim holds an outbound AI request waiting for the Locke desktop app's verdict before failing closed and blocking it. Must exceed worst-case screening time on the slowest machine it is deployed to, or healthy sends will be blocked.

lockedSettings.description: Subset of the property names above that the user is not permitted to override via the popup UI. Names listed here render as read-only in the popup with a 'managed by your organisation' hint.
